review.dependencies: MobileApp uses official Xboard Laravel/Sanctum/Eloquent; no new Composer packages; no remote code loaders.
review.configuration: No production secrets in plugin source. Play adapter is a non-production fixture. HTTPS is required in production.
review.keyManagement: Sanctum tokens issued by official AuthService. Plugin stores only purchase token hashes and opaque identifiers.
review.webRisks: Parameterized Eloquent queries; opaque IDs compared with hash_equals; request size, pagination, rate limit, replay uniqueness and RTDN HMAC are enforced.
